summary: Phase B multi-symbol refactor preserves Phase A single-asset behavior. Aggregate metrics and per-regime PnL are identical to-the-cent. Byte-level SHA-256 drifted on the CSV outputs; cause is most likely tiny float-ordering differences in trade confidence (full float64 precision) introduced by the refactored signal-handling order. The drift does not affect any financial metric and falls well within the user-specified tolerance criteria.

tolerance_check.criteria: From baseline.phase_b_acceptance_criteria — fall back when hashes drift but financial behavior is preserved

drift_analysis.what_changed: Backtester refactored from single-position state (cash, shares, entry_*) to multi-position dict[str, SimPosition]. New code paths added for pair-fill atomicity, orphan detection, pair PnL attribution. None of these new paths fire on a single-asset SPY run.
drift_analysis.why_hashes_drift: Cannot pinpoint exact byte-level cause. Hypothesis: trade-level confidence values are stored as float64 at full precision (~16 significant digits). The refactored signal-handling order may produce floats whose final ULP differs from Phase A even when the resulting financial state is identical. Differences below 1 cent are absorbed by .round(2) aggregation in regime_breakdown but persist in the raw CSV bytes.
drift_analysis.why_this_is_acceptable: All financial metrics — equity, per-regime PnL, total trades, Sharpe, max DD, peak equity — match the baseline exactly. The user-specified tolerance criteria pass with margins ~10x tighter than the allowed thresholds. The byte-level SHA hash is a fragile equality test; the financial behavior test is the meaningful one and it passes.

additional_phase_b_change.description: Final walk-forward window record is now correctly emitted. Phase A had 12 windows recorded in the JSON; Phase B emits 13 (the post-loop fall-through window was previously dropped). This is a bug fix, not a regression — total trade count is unchanged at 158.
additional_phase_b_change.evidence: Phase A baseline JSON walk_forward_windows length: 12. Phase B run: 13 entries (window_id 0..12).

coverage: SimPosition lifecycle (lazy init, qty signed, direction property)
Multi-symbol equity calculation (long, short, mixed, flat, missing-bar fallback)
Pair fill atomicity (both fill / neither / one-leg-unwind)
Conditional CSV column emission (legacy 13-col when no pair, +pair_id/pair_pnl when present)
Pair P&L attribution after both legs close
PerformanceAnalyzer.pair_breakdown (empty, solo, single round-trip, multiple round-trips, multi-pair sort, orphan exclusion)
